description: This source file defines the QRScannerView struct, which conforms to UIViewControllerRepresentable, integrating a custom data scanner view controller into SwiftUI. It manages QR code scanning, processes recognized data, and handles errors and lifecycle events.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: A delegate class for managing QR scanner events, error reporting, and handling recognized QR code items.

methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController, with support checks and error handling.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: Updates the UIKit view controller; currently empty as no updates are needed.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops the scanner and calls onDismiss when the view controller is dismantled.

methods.description: Creates a Coordinator instance for handling delegate callbacks.
